The Director, Financial Solutions helps AHEAD structure strategic financing solutions, improve cash outcomes, support complex transactions, and enable financial selling across the business. They will manage and support their direct reports (client services team) in order to develop and maintain a high performing team. The Director will work in partnership with the Security Leaders and Sales teams to ensure Practice deliverables to customers are complete, consistent, high quality, on time and deliver valued outcomes. They work in partnership with the team to ensure the Practice is executing and delivering on our financial commitments of margin and revenue recognition to the business. You will collaborate with internal teams and clients and may travel on-site to support rack delivery and installation.

Beyond individual requests, you will help build and maintain AHEAD’s knowledge assets, databases and proposal and use-case material, using scripts and automation to prepare and validate data, while continuing to grow with the industry. jobs.title: Control & Estimation Intern
jobs.description_text: About the Role We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on. These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation. Your mission The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions. Responsibilities Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment. Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines. Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware. Documentation: Doc

Daarom zijn we op zoek naar een allround stagiair die ons kan ondersteunen bij het continue activeren van onze klanten. Bij Crisp bevind je je in een uitdagende omgeving met veel kansen om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Wat je gaat doen Als Werkstudent Customer Retention krijg je een uniek inzicht in de wereld van consumentenpsychologie en de rol van marketing in consumentengedrag. Je ondersteunt de campagne & promotion specialists in ons Retentie-team bij een breed scala aan marketingtools, van promoties en prijzen tot heractivatie- en nieuwsbriefcampagnes. Je neemt volledig deel aan het Retentie-team en werkt nauw samen met onze Campaign- & Promotion Specialists, en onze Head of Retention. Enkele voorbeelden van wat je gaat doen: End-to-end uitvoering van e-mailcampagnes; van het aanvragen en selecteren van de juiste inhoud tot het instellen en uitvoeren van de technische details en het analyseren van de resultaten. 360-graden-uitvoering van onze promotiecampagnes, inclusief het selecteren van de optimale promotieproducten, het afstemmen met het forecast- en buyerteam, het creëren en verzenden van communicatie via meerdere kanalen, en het analyseren van resultaten. jobs.description_text: System Engineer – Machine Control Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Senior, 8+ years of relevant experience About us AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase, small, and growing. The role You own how our tool is controlled and operated. The machine combines lasers, high-speed cameras, a nanometer-precision wafer stage and GPU-based image reconstruction. Every measurement depends on these parts working together in tight synchronization. You are the system engineer for that layer: the control architecture, the timing, the machine software, and the data path from sensor to result. You work side by side with our system engineer for the metrology hardware and with our algorithms team, and together you lead the system. Join our global team and help build technology that strengthens trust in financial information. As an Account Executive at Caseware, you play a central role in driving revenue growth. You expand our presence in the market, win new customers and strengthen relationships with existing ones. With strong closing skills and a sharp eye for new opportunities within your portfolio, you help build sustainable revenue and long-term partnerships. You also increase Caseware’s visibility by building a relevant network and positioning our solutions confidently in the market. Your work has a direct impact on customer loyalty, market position and the long-term success of the company. What you will be doing: Drive active sales of Caseware’s solutions through consultative conversations, product presentations and confident management of the full sales cycle, working closely with Marketing, Consulting and Product Management. Build and expand long-term customer relationships based on a clear understanding of individual needs, strengthening satisfaction, loyalty and future growth opportunities. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description_text: The role Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you'll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. You'll take ideas from concept to production quickly, prove what works, and turn the best of it into patterns the wider engineering organisation can adopt. You'll work closely with product and commercial leaders to find where AI changes the economics of our affiliate marketing platform: what we can build, how fast, and at what cost. You'll be hands-on most of the time, writing code, shipping and measuring results, rather than coordinating others. You'll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won't be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real. This is a step-up opportunity. We're looking for a bright, self-starting engineer who is ready for more scope than their current role allows. You might not have held a principal title yet. What matters is that you're already building this way, you learn fast, and you want the room to prove it. You'll have direct access to senior leadership, real problems with commercial weight, and the freedom to choose how you solve them.
